The 2.5 kn flood statement applies only to a narrow stream running north from Lismore lighthouse across towards the Morvern shore and then northeast towards Shuna Island; it is not a passage-wide north-going rate or spring/neap observation.
The 4 kn statement is springs-only on the ebb and localized off the Morvern shore northwest of Bernera, setting southeast with overfalls; it is not a passage-wide south-going or neap rate.

A preserved legacy generic Sound of Mull record has matching nominal beginnings but different identity, direction and shared modelled rates; it is not reused, revised or treated as Lynn of Morvern evidence.
